summary: Iteration 293 — Configurable Internal Invoice System: All features tested and working correctly. Backend: 28/28 tests passed. Frontend: All UI components verified and functional including InvoiceConfigPanel (3 sub-tabs), ManualInvoiceDialog with hybrid master-select, and live totals calculation.
critical_code_review_comments: Master Data CRUD: All 4 types (account, cost_center, cost_object, project) work correctly with duplicate code detection (409 Conflict)
Number Ranges: Pattern validation correctly rejects patterns without counter ({####}, {###}, {##}), is_default is exclusive
Templates: Required/visible fields configuration works, is_default is exclusive, delete blocked when template in use
Manual Invoice: Pflichtfeld validation returns 400 with code='missing_required_fields' and fields list
Invoice Number Allocation: Atomic counter works - sequential numbers RE-2026-0001, RE-2026-0002, etc.
Tax Calculation: Discount applied before tax - 10% discount on 1000 = 900 net, 7% tax = 63, gross = 963
PDF Generation: Returns application/pdf with >1000 bytes, includes header/footer/payment-terms from template snapshot
Accounting Update: PUT /api/invoices/{id}/accounting works on draft invoices, updates cost_center/account/cost_object/project_code
DATEV Export: UTF-8 BOM, semicolon delimiter, all 12 columns present (Rechnungsnummer, Datum, Empfänger, Konto, Kostenstelle, Kostenträger, Projekt, Brutto, Netto, MwSt, Währung, Status)

Capabilities: All 4 new capabilities (invoices.manage_templates, invoices.manage_master_data, invoices.create_manual, invoices.set_accounting) work correctly, admin has all by default, non-admin without cap gets 403
seed_data_creation: Test templates, number ranges, and master data created during testing - cleanup fixture removes test data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 293 fully tested. Key findings: (1) Admin → System → Rechnungen-Setup tab shows InvoiceConfigPanel with 3 sub-tabs (Vorlagen, Nummernkreise, Stammdaten), (2) Templates sub-tab shows list with Name, Pflichtfelder, MwSt %, Standard columns and edit/delete buttons, (3) Number Ranges dialog shows Pattern field with placeholder help text '{PREFIX} {YYYY} {YY} {MM} {####} {###} {##}', (4) Master Data sub-tab has type selector (Konten/Kostenstellen/Kostenträger/Projekte) with Code, Bezeichnung, Beschreibung, Aktiv columns, (5) Resources → Rechnungen → 'Manuelle Rechnung' button opens dialog with template/range selectors, hybrid master-select for accounting fields (dropdown + 'Frei' toggle), line items with live totals (Netto/MwSt/Brutto), (6) Invoice numbers are sequential (RE-2026-0001, RE-2026-0002, etc.), (7) Default template has cost_center and issue_date as required fields - tests must include these.
